name: load-tests
description: Local k6 workloads for the chess backend

scripts.test:smoke: npm run typecheck && npm run smoke:auth
scripts.baseline:stats: npm run typecheck && node run-k6.mjs --report results/stats.json read-statistics.ts
scripts.baseline:stats:1vu: npm run typecheck && VUS=1 node run-k6.mjs --report results/stats-1vu.json read-statistics.ts
scripts.baseline:stats:5vu: npm run typecheck && VUS=5 node run-k6.mjs --report results/stats-5vu.json read-statistics.ts
scripts.baseline:stats:20vu: npm run typecheck && VUS=20 node run-k6.mjs --report results/stats-20vu.json read-statistics.ts
scripts.test:game: npm run typecheck && npm run smoke:game
scripts.baseline:games:1: npm run typecheck && GAMES=1 node run-k6.mjs --report results/games-1.json concurrent-games.ts
scripts.baseline:games:5: npm run typecheck && GAMES=5 node run-k6.mjs --report results/games-5.json concurrent-games.ts
scripts.baseline:games:20: npm run typecheck && GAMES=20 node run-k6.mjs --report results/games-20.json concurrent-games.ts
scripts.baseline:games:50: npm run typecheck && GAMES=50 node run-k6.mjs --report results/games-50.json concurrent-games.ts
scripts.baseline:games:100: npm run typecheck && GAMES=100 node run-k6.mjs --report results/games-100.json concurrent-games.ts
